footer.tagline: Domek — a household planner for the people who live there.

landing.heroSubtitle: One shared place for your calendar, chores, lists, and expenses.
landing.heroByline: Like the list on the fridge, but for everything.
landing.featureCalendarSummary: Birthdays, bins, school days, guests, and all the little dates that keep the house moving.
landing.featureTodosSummary: The small jobs that used to live on scraps of paper and kitchen counters.
landing.featureShoppingSummary: Shared lists for the weekly shop, top-ups, and the things you always forget.
landing.featureNotesSummary: Wi-Fi notes, trip lists, pet care, and anything worth being able to find again.
landing.featureExpensesSummary: Shared costs, repairs, supplies, and the odd surprise bill - all in one place.
landing.featureChoresSummary: Recurring jobs, without the weekly “who did what” debate.
